items.briefing:
Australian employees are using AI tools more than ever, but research from Glean highlights a growing concern: AI is creating hidden workloads, with staff spending extra time managing, checking, and correcting AI outputs rather than saving time. Separately, a warning for anyone using AI to produce professional documents — a US court case revealed an expert witness used ChatGPT to write a legal report, which contained serious errors. This is a timely reminder that AI-generated content must always be carefully reviewed before use.

**Practical tip:** Before sharing any AI-generated document or report, always read it thoroughly and verify key facts from a trusted source.

featured.title: Proofpoint warns of myGov & invoice scams in Australia
featured.quote: Australians lost $2.18 billion to scams in 2025 using fake myGov and invoice tactics.
